Keywords: sign up, register, account, email, password, social login, free trial, onboarding, passkey
Section Order: One-line promise of what you get > Form with email and one more field > Social or passkey options > Terms line > Link to log in > Short proof beside the form
Primary CTA Placement: The submit button inside the form, labelled with the outcome
Color Strategy: Quiet page; one action colour; error and success colours that pass contrast
Recommended Effects: Inline validation on blur; password reveal toggle; no decorative motion
Conversion Optimization: Ask for as little as possible; allow paste into password fields; show rules before typing; do not ask for a card unless needed; land users inside the product after sign-up
Use When: A product needs accounts and the user has decided to try it
Avoid When: The first value can be given without an account; show it first
Mobile: Correct input types and autocomplete tokens; button above the keyboard
Accessibility: Labels not placeholders; autocomplete attributes (SC 1.3.5); no cognitive test to log in (SC 3.3.8); errors in text and linked to fields
Slop Habits: a split screen with a floating dashboard mock; 'join 10,000 teams' with no source; confirm-password field

Keywords: log in, sign in, password, reset, forgot, two factor, magic link, passkey, session
Section Order: Sign in form > Alternative methods > Forgot password > Create account link > Help link
Primary CTA Placement: Submit inside the form; recovery link directly under the password field
Color Strategy: Plain ground; error text and icon, not colour alone
Recommended Effects: None beyond focus; show spinner on submit
Conversion Optimization: Say what went wrong without leaking whether an account exists; support password managers; offer passkeys
Use When: Returning users must get in fast
Avoid When: Public content that needs no account
Mobile: Keyboard types right; biometric prompt where available
Accessibility: Accessible authentication: allow paste and managers, no memory puzzle (SC 3.3.8); focus moves to the first error
Slop Habits: captcha on first try; a marketing hero beside the form; vague 'something went wrong'

Keywords: pricing, plans, tiers, subscription, monthly, yearly, free plan, compare, billing, enterprise
Section Order: One-line value > Two to four plans with price, limit and button > Full comparison table > What happens at the limit > Billing questions > Talk to us for large teams
Primary CTA Placement: A button in every plan card; the recommended plan has the strongest button
Color Strategy: Neutral cards; one highlight on the recommended plan with a text label, not colour alone
Recommended Effects: Monthly and yearly toggle that updates prices at once; no hover-only content
Conversion Optimization: Price in plain figures with tax stated; name the limit that moves you up; show what a downgrade does; keep plan names short and descriptive
Use When: The product is sold by subscription or usage
Avoid When: Price is by quote; use quote or enterprise pattern
Mobile: Plans stack with the recommended plan first; table scrolls inside its own region
Accessibility: Comparison is a real table with headers (SC 1.3.1); toggle is a labelled switch with state (SC 4.1.2)
Slop Habits: three identical cards with the middle one glowing; 'most popular' on the plan nobody picks; features list of checkmarks with no detail

Keywords: dashboard, overview, metrics, widgets, kpi, activity, table, filters, admin, owner view
Section Order: Page title and date range > Three key numbers with change > Main chart or list > Recent activity > Tasks needing action > Shortcuts
Primary CTA Placement: The most common task as one primary button in the page header
Color Strategy: Neutral surface; colour kept for status and the data series; each status paired with text
Recommended Effects: Number updates with polite announcement; skeletons; no animated counters
Conversion Optimization: Put the thing the user came to do first; show empty states with a next step; keep numbers comparable
Use When: Signed-in users check state and act
Avoid When: First-time visitors who have no data yet; give them onboarding
Mobile: Cards in one column with the key number first; tables become lists
Accessibility: Charts have text or table equivalents (SC 1.1.1); status not by colour alone (SC 1.4.1); focus order follows reading order
Slop Habits: twelve equal widgets; neon charts on black; invented figures in screenshots

Keywords: checkout, payment, basket, cart, shipping, card, wallet, order summary, tax, receipt
Section Order: Order summary with total > Contact > Delivery or collection > Payment > Review > Confirmation with receipt
Primary CTA Placement: Pay button at the end of the form, labelled with the amount
Color Strategy: Plain ground and single action colour; padlock text not a trust badge collage
Recommended Effects: Inline validation; totals update without layout jump
Conversion Optimization: Guest checkout; address lookup; wallets; show delivery cost early; keep the summary visible; clear error recovery without losing entries
Use When: The user is ready to pay
Avoid When: Payment is taken offline or on delivery
Mobile: Sticky total; wallet buttons first; numeric keyboard for card
Accessibility: Do not ask for the same data twice (SC 3.3.7); autocomplete tokens; errors linked (SC 3.3.1); session timeout warning (SC 2.2.1)
Slop Habits: upsell modal on the pay step; pre-ticked add-ons; fake stock countdown

Keywords: onboarding, setup, checklist, first run, activation, getting started, tour, empty state, progress
Section Order: Next step prominent > Checklist of three to five steps > Sample data option > Help link > Skip
Primary CTA Placement: The next step's button in the first card
Color Strategy: Calm; progress shown with text and shape
Recommended Effects: Step completion tick with polite text; no confetti
Conversion Optimization: Reach first value in one session; allow skipping; save progress; offer sample data
Use When: A new account has nothing to look at
Avoid When: A product that works at once with no setup
Accessibility: Progress as text '2 of 4' (SC 1.3.1); skip control reachable
Slop Habits: a six-slide product tour on first load; mascot chat bubbles; forced email verification before any value

Keywords: settings, account, profile, billing, notifications, security, delete account, export, preferences
Section Order: Section navigation > Profile > Security > Notifications > Billing > Danger zone with export first
Primary CTA Placement: Save per section, disabled until a change
Color Strategy: Neutral; destructive actions in a clearly named colour with text
Conversion Optimization: Make cancel and export easy to find; confirm destructive acts with named consequences
Accessibility: Headings per section; switches labelled; confirmations are real dialogs with focus handling
Slop Habits: cancel hidden behind chat; toggles with no label; guilt copy on cancel

Keywords: booking flow, reserve, schedule, availability, steps, confirm, reminder, reschedule, cancel
Section Order: Choose service > Choose time > Details > Pay or confirm > Confirmation > Manage booking
Primary CTA Placement: Continue button fixed at the bottom of each step
Color Strategy: Plain; selected state by outline and tick
Recommended Effects: Step transitions short, off with reduced motion
Conversion Optimization: Remember details; show the price and policy early; allow edit from summary
Use When: Bookings are made by many people inside a product
Avoid When: A single phone number would do
Accessibility: Step list announced; no drag to choose a time (SC 2.5.7)
Slop Habits: progress bar with six tiny steps; login wall before availability

Keywords: docs, api, quick start, sdk, reference, code sample, install, developer, keys, changelog
Section Order: Install and first call in code > Guides by task > Reference > Examples > Status and changelog > Support
Primary CTA Placement: Get API key and read quick start side by side
Color Strategy: Neutral; code blocks with a theme that passes contrast
Recommended Effects: Copy button with text confirmation; search shortcut
Conversion Optimization: Working snippet above the fold; real versions; keyboard search
Mobile: Search first; code scrolls inside its box
Accessibility: Code blocks reachable by keyboard; copy confirmation announced (SC 4.1.3)
Slop Habits: a terminal animation that is not runnable; hero with fake dashboard; no version labels

Aliases: Get the app|Mobile app landing|Store badge page
Keywords: app store, download, mobile app, install, qr code, screenshots, ratings, android, ios
Section Order: Name and one benefit > Store buttons > Real screenshots > Three things it does > Ratings with source > Privacy summary > Support
Primary CTA Placement: Store badges in hero; device-aware link
Color Strategy: App colours; screenshots carry the page
Conversion Optimization: Detect device; show a QR code on desktop; link straight to the right store; show real ratings
Avoid When: Web app that needs no install
Mobile: One badge for the visitor's platform
Slop Habits: phone mockups floating at angles; invented download counts

Keywords: waitlist, early access, coming soon, launch, notify, invite, pre-order, teaser
Section Order: What it is and for whom > One email field > What happens next with a date > Honest preview > Founder note > Social links
Primary CTA Placement: Email field and button in first screen
Color Strategy: Brand colour with a plain ground
Recommended Effects: One subtle product preview; no loops
Conversion Optimization: Give a date range; confirm by email; show position only if true
Use When: The product is not open yet
Slop Habits: 'something big is coming'; fake counters of people joined

Keywords: compare, versus, alternative, switch, migrate, differences, table, honest, features
Section Order: Who it is for > Side-by-side table > Where the other option wins > Migration steps > Pricing difference > Start button
Primary CTA Placement: After the table and in the header
Conversion Optimization: Be honest about trade-offs; date the facts; cite sources
Mobile: Table scrolls in a labelled region
Accessibility: Table headers and scope (SC 1.3.1); tick and cross have text
Slop Habits: all ticks for us, all crosses for them; undated claims

Keywords: case study, customer story, results, problem, solution, quote, metrics, client, project
Section Order: Result in one sentence > The client and the problem > What was done > Numbers with dates > Quote with name and role > Related stories > Contact
Primary CTA Placement: After results and at the end
Conversion Optimization: Use real numbers from the client; link to a live result
Slop Habits: vague 'increased engagement 300%'; logo wall without stories

Aliases: Enterprise page|Book a demo|Talk to sales
Keywords: enterprise, sales, demo, security, compliance, procurement, sso, contract, contact
Section Order: Who it is for > Security and compliance facts > Integrations > How a pilot works > Short demo request form > Procurement documents
Primary CTA Placement: Book a demo in header and after security
Conversion Optimization: Offer a self-serve alternative; list what happens after the form; ask only what sales needs
Slop Habits: logo wall of unconfirmed clients; 'trusted by industry leaders'

Keywords: status, uptime, incident, changelog, release notes, version, subscribe, maintenance
Section Order: Current state in words > Active incidents with times > Past incidents > Subscribe > Release list by date
Primary CTA Placement: Subscribe to updates at the top
Conversion Optimization: Honest times; plain cause and fix
Slop Habits: a green 'all systems operational' that is hardcoded

Keywords: help, support, knowledge base, faq, articles, search, contact, troubleshooting
Section Order: Search > Top questions > Categories > Article > Contact options
Conversion Optimization: Show answers in results; track searches with no result
Slop Habits: chatbot first; FAQ accordion of one-word questions

Keywords: thank you, confirmation, receipt, order number, next steps, success, booked
Section Order: What happened > Reference number > What to expect and when > Add to calendar or track > Contact > One optional next step
Primary CTA Placement: The most useful next action, not an upsell
Conversion Optimization: Reduce anxiety; send the same by email
Accessibility: Focus moves to heading; success announced (SC 4.1.3)
